iconSet.decision: Owner-supplied official Konami icon pack (2026-10-28) + Link marker (2026-10-28). Attribute/race/spell-trap normalized; MD ban + ATK/DEF kept; Link marker pixel-art with per-arrow red active state. LIST and GRID: bare ban on thumbnail/art top-left.
iconSet.copyright: Konami / 4K Media; used as-is for OTCP mockups and product UI.

attribute.note: Official attribute emblems; transparent circular PNG from owner pack.

property.note: Spell/Trap property icons from owner Race/ folder.

cardType.note: Master Duel-style mini card-frame glyphs from owner Frames-mini screenshots (2026-10-28). Tight bbox, transparent BG. FIRST icon in every list/finder/editor row and detail chip row. Replaces prior spell-trap/spell.png + trap.png type badges (moved to fallback/pre-frame-mini-spell-trap-type-20261028/). Full-size frame art remains under frame/.

level.note: Level/Rank star. Owner pack level.png is 20×20 (identical to prior); kept. No sharper Rank/Link marker in pack. Number rendered beside icon.

atk.note: Master Duel ATK — geom-v2 flaring pointed outlined blade (approved). Unchanged this pass.

def.note: Master Duel DEF shield (approved). Unchanged this pass.

banLimited.label: Limited
banLimited.note: Master Duel Limited (1) kept. Owner Limit/limited_1.png archived under source-owner/limit/ and fallback/pre-owner-pack-20261028/owner-limit/; MD set is complete (Forbidden + Unlimited) and already approved.

banSemiLimited.label: Semi-Limited
banSemiLimited.note: Master Duel Semi-Limited (2) kept (see banLimited note).

banForbidden.label: Forbidden
banForbidden.note: Master Duel Forbidden kept. Owner Limit pack has no Forbidden equivalent.

banUnlimited.label: Unlimited
banUnlimited.note: Master Duel Unlimited (3) kept; detail-only. Owner Limit pack has limited_0 only (not used).

rarity.note: Stored for future list/detail rarity marks; not used in current Ink mocks.

frame.note: Full card-frame type art (not the mini glyphs). Mini list/detail type icons are under frame-mini/ (kinds.cardType).

cardBack.note: Official card back; used as ART thumbnail / grid tile placeholder in Ink mocks.

link.note: Owner pixel-art Link marker. PNGs trimmed to visible arrow-tip bounds. Rows: 16 CSS px square (same visible height as attribute/race/frame-mini/level/ATK/DEF); no Link-N text. Detail chips: 18 CSS px + Link-N label. RUNTIME: base.svg per-arrow groups lit from card linkmarkers. Do not pre-render all 255 combos until real card data (see fallback/link-combos-unused/).

usage: compact ban markers bare on thumbnail/art top-left (LIST + GRID); never Unlimited 3
Link monsters: marker icon only in list/finder/editor rows (24 CSS px); detail chips keep Link-N label; arrows lit at runtime from card linkmarkers via base.svg groups
iconSet.adr: ADR-012 (game extension declares its own presentation assets with filter declarations)

banMarkers.visibility: Deck views always; search/browse/collection/Lists only when a format filter is active. Unlimited (3) never on list/grid.
banMarkers.note: Bare MD icon on thumbnail/art top-left in LIST and GRID (no colored container; subtle drop-shadow). Full word in title/aria-label (NFR-11). Never Unlimited on list/grid.

rowAlignment.rule: Every meta icon in a row shares the same visible top and bottom (identical visible height), vertically centered. Driven by visible (non-transparent) bounds, not file box padding.
rowAlignment.link: PNGs trimmed to arrow-tip bbox; displayed at 16×16 (rows) / 18×18 (detail chips); nearest-neighbor scales.
rowAlignment.notes: All 8 Link arrow tips (incl. gray) stay inside the img box; outermost tip pixels on shared top/bottom. Ritual frame-mini still missing from owner pack.
